A few notes on how this site is put together.

ON THIS PAGE
The ideaCodeTypeInteraction

The idea

I wanted a personal site that felt separate from my game development portfolio. This one is closer to an index or field notebook. The dark rooms, warm paper, and little details come from games and stories I like, but the content is just my actual work and interests.

Code

Static HTML generated with a small Node.js script. CSS does most of the visual work. JavaScript handles the scroll scene, cursor, the RFID ability selector, and a couple of hidden things. No tracking or analytics.

Website source on GitHub ↗

Type

Cormorant Garamond gives the big headings their shape. IBM Plex Mono handles the small labels. Both are hosted here with their licences.

Interaction

The first scene opens as you scroll. It doesn’t change how the page scrolls, and it stays still if you prefer reduced motion. The rest of the site uses normal links and works without JavaScript.
